title: Managed warehouse for MLflow (Beta)
body: With managed warehouse, users can view traces stored in Unity Catalog in the MLflow UI without selecting a SQL warehouse. MLflow runs trace queries on a SQL warehouse that it creates in your workspace when your workspace supports it, and on serverless compute otherwise. Workspace admins can enable **Managed Warehouse for MLflow** on the [**Previews** page](/aws/en/admin/workspace-settings/manage-previews). See [Managed warehouse for MLflow traces](/aws/en/mlflow3/genai/tracing/managed-warehouse).
